final:
Morning at the Cliff's Edge

A lone Rückenfigur stands on a dark promontory between two bare young oaks, looking out over a sea of morning fog. A white bank of mist drifts in front of the stems, grey dawn clouds above a pale cream infinite, three birds aloft. Painted thinly on a warm ground — graphite underdrawing, lean washes blended and veiled, trunks drawn as tapering silhouettes — in Friedrich's quiet, contemplative manner.

final:
Morning over a Sea of Fog — Two Bare Trees

A grey dawn above, a warm infinite cream sea of fog, and a dark cliff firm against the light. Two slender bare trees frame the distance — the left fuller, the right lean — with a tiny dark Rückenfigur standing at the centre of the edge, looking out. Two quiet boulders with small grass tufts ground the foreground, and birds cross the luminous void. Painted thin throughout over a warm ground with graphite below, in Friedrich's manner: no impasto, no distant ridge or ruin left, only mist, light, and the watcher.

final:
Watcher above the Sea of Fog

A grey dawn over an infinite cream sea of mist, seen from a dark cliff. Two slender bare oaks frame the light left and right, a tiny Rückenfigur stands at the centre of the lip, two quiet boulders with faint dry tufts lie in the turf, six birds cross the pale sky. Painted very thin over graphite and a warm ground, in the manner of Friedrich — no impasto, losses left as mist.

final:
"Watcher at the Edge of Fog"

A grey-blue dawn over an infinite cream sea of fog, seen from a dark cliff. Two slender bare oaks frame the light — the left fuller, the right leaner — and a tiny dark Rückenfigur stands at the centre of the lip, with six birds in the middle distance. Thin oil throughout over red-ocher and lead ground, with graphite below; the first plan's ridge, ruin and sun-glow dissolved into mist and were left there.
